notes.title: Effect Update - 1.0.2
notes.content:
Welcome back all throwers and eaters
Our second point of timeline is now out. Check out new mechanic added to the game. There have also been lot of changes and there may still be new changes, because of balancing game. In short, what changed: New effect system, items stats changes, more visual particles, fix sound effects and new item.
[hr][/hr]
New Features

 Effect system
 New Item
 Changes
 Fixes

[hr][/hr]
Effect system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/2c78c406174d191826299004761720095f481168.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/9ad6273319939ff7729605735d529d2730949943.png

 Players now can get effects by eating something or get hit by someone.
 New 7 effects (4 Positive, 3 Negative)

[hr][/hr]
New Item
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/45598ccb84c1b576134dd69a05a40ebf063172ef.png

 Medicament

[hr][/hr]
Changes

 Loot boxes and supply drops now have 3D sound
 New break sound
 New explosion sound
 Banana - Heal from 45 to 40 hp, effect added
 Box of candles - Chance drop from supply drop from 1% to 0.5%
 Crystal - Damage from 24 to 22 hp, effect added
 Electro Machete - Damage from 42 to 38, 2 effects added
 Hot coal - Damage from 22 to 14 hp, effect added
 Poison - Damage from 31 to 26 hp, effect added
 Rotten apple - Heal from -4 to -1 hp, effect added
 Saw axe - Damage from 32 to 30 hp, effect added
 Sword - effect added

[hr][/hr]
Fixes

 Fixed a Slot 10 in setting, now you can also rebind it.
 Fixed XP achievment
 Fixed fire stick particle effect stimulation space from local to world. Now the particle is not static in hand.

notes.title: Throweat Area - Coming on November 29th
notes.content:
Welcome future throwers and eaters.

Troweat area is a FPS multiplayer game with super chaotic mechanic of throwing EVERYTHING and eating EVERYTHING.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/81584fb70db49bf4eb8a28320d16a428511ecdca.png
And like in game now you have time to prepare before madness starts. Before Stones, tables, knifes, and more will be full of sky. Life in the area is short but rewards are big. Lets look to features.
[hr][/hr]
Features

 Arena battle for max 10 players.
 40+ items that you can collect, throw or eat
 50+ cosmetics on your player character and items.
 Quest system and chests to open

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45295339/148cd7a50d53c39ff7a53372efd4109ad59655f8.png
Explosions are coming so don´t miss release!
